Original daily consumption:
- Monday: \(2 \times 20 = 40\) oz
- Tuesday: \(3 \times 20 = 60\) oz
- Wednesday: \(2 \times 20 = 40\) oz
- Thursday: \(3 \times 20 = 60\) oz
- Friday: \(1 \times 20 = 20\) oz

New consumption:
- Monday: \(40 \times \frac14 = 10\)
- Tuesday: \(60 \times \frac14 = 15\)
- Wednesday: \(40 \times \frac12 = 20\)
- Thursday: \(60 \times \frac14 = 15\)
- Friday: \(20 \times \frac12 = 10\)

Total: \(10+15+20+15+10=70\)

\boxed{70}
